parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-credential-description --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --credential-id cred_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --description credential_description --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateCredentialDescription --region cn-hangzhou --Description credential_description --CredentialId cred_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
